name: ai-skills
description: Portable, harness-agnostic agent skills — prose-only disciplines that run on any agent able to read text

plugins.name: unbreakable
plugins.description: Design discipline in three parts: invariants enforced so that violating them is unrepresentable — enforcement ladders, illegal-state elimination, choke-point design; every choice that is not an invariant derived from the situation rather than inherited from habit; and the record of the work — what gets filed, written down, and left behind — kept so the developer never has to hold what could have been parked

plugins.name: dreamy
plugins.description: Maintenance loop for Claude Code's long-term memory, run as one command by dream: session-analysis distills the session transcripts into a 'dream' overview of what deserves remembering; improve-memory consumes it — merging duplicates, resolving contradictions, promoting findings, and proposing CLAUDE.md upgrades as a crib sheet pointing at rules files — auto-applying the obvious and flagging the rest as checkboxes for approval; send-results is how any of them, or any other automation, reports back — a short summary emailed under one fixed Gmail label with links that open the produced file in the IDE

plugins.name: machinery
plugins.description: The union of two projects' Claude process machinery, made to run: always-on universal rules, a PRULE:/URULE: rule-capture loop with automatic intake, a quiet-output filter, a worktree-create hook, and a per-project commit gate installed by /machinery:install.
